# PCA plots

PCA analysis of count data. Using PCAtools and DESEq2 rlog data we can visualize the samples in a PCA plot,
both with and without combatseq batch correction


## without batch correction {.tabset}

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(PCAtools)

if (exists("snakemake")) {
    uncorrected_counts <- snakemake@input[["uncorrected_counts"]]
    batch_corrected_counts <- snakemake@input[["batch_corrected_counts"]]
} else {

}

dds_obj <- readRDS(uncorrected_counts)

rlog_obj <- rlog(dds_obj, blind=TRUE)

rlog_mat <- assay(rlog_obj)
```
